messages:
Maya Patel: Quick design review — added a prototype for the Vectors Preview modal you hit after a batch upload. Link: https://staging.redwood.host/vectors-preview :eyes:
Samir Khan: Checking it now. first thought: focus trap? When modal opens keyboard focus lands on search but tabbing escapes to background page. Needs a proper trap. :thinking:
Alex Chen: Love the compact rows. Small copy change: 'Export vectors' feels generic — suggest 'Download CSV (vectors)' or just 'Download CSV'. Also the CTA color is hard to parse with dark theme.
Priya Rao: Accessibility nits from quick scan — aria-live for the "processing" status, announce how many vectors loaded once preview finishes, and screen-reader labels for the similarity score column. Also low contrast on the relevance badge (0.5 vs 1.0).
Maya Patel: Good calls. For the focus trap I wired a `focus-lock` wrapper but must have missed an edge case. Will add tests for keyboard only flow.
Samir Khan: Another perf thing — for 100k row batch preview we only render first 100. We should make that explicit in copy: "Showing first 100 of 100,000 — download full CSV". Otherwise users will assume it's full. :warning:
Alex Chen: Agree. Also suggest adding keyboard shortcuts: `j/k` to move rows, `space` to select, and `d` to open download menu. Make sure we document these in the tooltip.
Priya Rao: For screen readers, avoid `j/k` shorthand as primary discovery — keep a keyboard help panel reachable via `?` and ensure it's not the only way to learn shortcuts.
Maya Patel: Proposed CSV header snippet for export:
```
id,text,embedding_768,similarity_score
123,"How do I reset password?","[0.01, -0.34, ...]",0.87
```
We'll stream the CSV on the backend to avoid memory spikes.
Samir Khan: From infra side, streaming is fine but add a rate limit/timeout for huge exports. Also telemetry: tag exports with sample count and duration.
ui-bot: deploy-bot: Staging build 2026-02-21T14:05 deployed for `vectors-preview-a11y` branch.
Alex Chen: UI nit — the relevance column header should be sortable, and the default sort needs to be stable (tie-break by id). If we auto-rerank on the fly, indicate that with a subtle spinner in the header.
Priya Rao: Screen reader note: when sorting changes, fire a polite announcement like "Sorted by relevance, highest first" via `aria-live="polite"`.
Maya Patel: I'll push an update: focus trap fix, explicit "showing X of Y" copy, CSV copy tweak to "Download CSV", aria-live announcements, and add visible keyboard help (`?`). Will ping again when ready. :sparkles:
Samir Khan: Thanks — once patched let's test with NVDA/VoiceOver and a 100k synthetic batch.
Alex Chen: Also add a small tooltip on export button: "Includes raw vectors and similarity scores — may contain user data" for privacy/consent clarity.
Priya Rao: LGTM otherwise. Happy to proof copy and run quick color contrast checks.
Maya Patel: Thanks all — PR incoming in 20m.
